kind: Airbender Prime security upgrade obligations; not a security certificate

observations.finding: Default recursive transcript is Blake2sTranscript<true>, with seven-round reduced BLAKE2s.
Proximity query selection uses PessimisticConjectureMode, including a heuristic 20 percent query margin.
BabyBear quartic and Proth120 challenge fields have approximately 123.63 and 122.81 bits of order; algebraic bounds lose additional degree factors. PoW accounting closes the classical target gap.
Final WHIR schedule uses per-round grinding between 21 and 30 bits, plus other grinding challenges.

Full-round Blake2sU32MerkleTreeWithCap<Global,false> still associates Blake2sForEverythingVerifier, whose hash rounds use global USE_REDUCED_BLAKE2_ROUNDS=true. Custom hash profile requires matching verifier changes, not just tree type selection.
observations.scope: Configuration mismatch for custom full-round instantiation; not a claim of an attack against the default reduced-round profile.

required_work.deliverable: Adversary query/work/memory budget and acceptable total failure probability; distinguish 128-bit work factor from 2^-128 statistical error.
Sumcheck, lookups, memory argument, WHIR proximity, Merkle binding, transcript transformation and recursive composition bounds for actual implementation.

required_work.task: Replace heuristic proximity margin for formally justified profile
required_work.deliverable: Applicable theorem with finite-field correction terms and exact query schedule, or explicitly retained conjecture.
Applicable QROM reduction and concrete losses; do not add classical grinding bits unchanged.

required_work.task: Select challenge fields/repetitions and hash outputs jointly
required_work.deliverable: Larger fields or independent repetitions if required by derived bound; hash collision/preimage/collapsing requirements and reduced-round assumption explicitly justified.
Versioned base, inner verifier, feeder and final proof configurations; regenerate verifier binaries/circuits and measure total proof size.

required_work.deliverable: Prove compiler/constraint correspondence, guest binary and transition statement binding; keep cryptographic assumptions explicit.

not_claimed: No 128-bit quantum-security parameter set derived yet.
No whole-protocol attack inferred solely from generic quantum search or hash collision complexity.
No theorem that increasing query count or final wrapper security repairs weaker inner layers.
